summary: Auth-cache + tenancy-cache session verified end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed against the deployed preview URL, including cache-hit, logout invalidation (no 30s stale window), expired session -> 401, role gates (patient 403 vs owner 200 on /api/admin/users/quarantined-duplicates), PATCH /auth/me freshness (phone reflected immediately), throwaway-patient DELETE /auth/me + immediate 401, owner DELETE /auth/me blocked with 403, and tenant scoping (correct clinic 200, non-member clinic 403) across /api/bookings/all, /api/surgeries, /api/prescriptions, /api/analytics/dashboard. Frontend web preview loads cleanly with an injected session token: dashboard + my-bookings render, cached_user + dc_owner + dc:bookings-all + dc:admin-overview localStorage keys are written by data-cache/auth.tsx (AsyncStorage persistence working), body renders quickly on repeat visit, zero console errors during boot. No React Native / expo-av / deprecated-package issues introduced by this session's changes.

tenancy._TENANCY_TTL=60s + invalidate_tenancy_cache called from upsert_membership: verified 403 still enforced on non-member clinic header (cache doesn't leak membership).
invalidate_user() in auth_cache.py does a linear scan of _cache — fine at _MAX_ENTRIES=5000 but worth watching if user count grows; not a bug.
DELETE /api/auth/me correctly 403s for staff/owner (test_owner_self_delete_is_blocked_403) — good guard rail.
